filtration_rate.basis: t P2O5 per m2 of filter per day

ammonia_consumption.basis: t NH3 per t P2O5 of DAP

electricity_consumption.basis: kWh per t P2O5, mine to bagged product

variable_cost.basis: variable cost per tonne of DAP

plant_p2o5_recovery.basis: P2O5 in the product plus the merchant acid over the P2O5 in the flotation feed

flotation_recovery.basis: registered recoveries of the rougher-cleaner circuit

acid_consumption.basis: t H2SO4 per t P2O5, stoichiometric demand plus the registered excess

water_soluble_loss.basis: water-soluble P2O5 lost with the gypsum, per cent of the P2O5 fed

specific_energy.basis: GJ per t P2O5: steam of the evaporators, fuel of the dryers and power

carbon_intensity.basis: kgCO2e per t P2O5, scope 1 and 2

stack_dust.basis: mg dust per Nm3 at the stack, the permitted limit

availability.basis: hours the reaction section was available

sulphur_consumption.basis: t sulphur per t P2O5 at 99.7% conversion

stack_fluoride.basis: mg F per Nm3 at the stack, the permitted limit

steam_consumption.basis: t steam per t P2O5 fed, weak acid at 28.5 % raised to 52 % at an economy of 3.0
